---
name: Factions
---
Formations that owe allegiance to one of the four chaos gods (Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh or Tzeentch) hate formations that owe allegiance to any other Chaos god. Formations that owe allegiance to Chaos Undivided do not hate any other formations nor do any other formations hate them.

A formation that has no units within 15cm of units from a hated formation receives a +1 modifier to its Action and Rally test rolls. Formations that have an allegiance and that are off board always received this +1 modifier.
